name: American Cross Country Championships
where: New Orleans, LA · host Tulane · Lake Oaks Park
headline: American Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Tulane swept the team titles at home in New Orleans. The Green Wave men scored 31 points to Tulsa's 56, with Silas Kiptanui winning the 8K in 23:28.7. The Tulane women scored 32 to Tulsa's 56, and Blezzin Kimutai won the 6K in 19:49.8.
